# ProjectMonsters Roster (generated site)

This repository holds nothing but the generated, published output of the
ProjectMonsters roster website. It has no other purpose and is intentionally
public.

**Do not edit files here by hand.** Every file is overwritten on each
successful run of the private `ProjectMonsters` repository's
`.github/workflows/roster-publish.yml` workflow, which pushes exactly the
validated, safety-checked `dist/` payload produced by
`Tools/RosterPublish/publish.py` and nothing else.

- Source and documentation: see `GitCheeseMaster/ProjectMonsters`'s
  `Docs/Systems/RosterPublishPipeline.md`.
- Published site: https://gitcheesemaster.github.io/ProjectMonsters-Roster/
